Class TacticNet

java.lang.Object
dev.swordai.core.rl.TacticNet
public final class TacticNet extends Object
The tactics model: a small network of its own that chooses, every Tactic.EVERY ticks, how the fighter fights until the next choice (Tactic). It reads the same numbers the acting network reads, among them what the opponent has been doing over the last seconds (ObsSpec.SC_STYLE_AWAY and the two after it), which the acting network had learned to make next to no use of. Its choice turns rules on and off and is handed to the acting network as an input (tactic.in in ActorNet), so that the acting network can learn to fight each way.

It learns at its own pace, from its own choices only, by PPO over the half-second steps it decides at (the manager of a hierarchy learns at its own time scale: FeUdal Networks, Vezhnevets et al. ICML 2017). What a choice brought is everything rewarded while it stood, discounted from the tick it was made, plus the critic's value of where it left the fighter; the critic does not see the tactic, so its value is the baseline the choice is measured against (see advantages(Rollout, float, float, float)).

It does not start from nothing. Training a manager from scratch is slow and unsteady, and the fighter learns on the screen at about a hundred updates an hour, so the model starts out with the plan it would be given by hand: crit back most of the time, space against an opponent that has been standing at the edge of the reach, and the other ways now and then to find out what they bring. That plan is a hand-set part of the network, learned on from there like the rest (as the swing in the air of ActorNet starts out knowing one rule).

    • advantages

      static float[] advantages(Rollout r, float lastValue, float gamma, float lambda)
      What each choice in the rollout brought over the critic's expectation, at the half-second scale (generalised advantage estimation over the choices, as for a semi-Markov decision process): for a choice made on step s that stood until step e, A = sum over s<=t<e of gamma^(t-s) delta_t + gamma^(e-s) lambda A_next, with delta_t the critic's own TD error of step t. The sum telescopes to the discounted reward while the choice stood plus the discounted value it left, minus the value it was made in. The next choice's part only counts when it was made in the same episode and recorded. Steps that are not choices are left at NaN.
      Parameters:
      lastValue - the value after the last stored step, as for Rollout.computeAdvantages(float, float, float)

    • update

      public TacticNet.Stats update(Rollout r, float lastValue, float gamma, float lambda, float lr, float clip, float entropyCoef, int epochs, float klStop, float maxGradNorm, Random rng)
      One PPO update of the tactics model on the choices recorded in r (clipped surrogate, advantages normalised over the choices, an entropy bonus, stopped early past klStop). The acting network and the critic are not touched. Fewer than four choices: nothing is learned.
